features.name: origin_delay_rate
features.description: Historical mean departure delay (min) at origin hub, learned on the training split

features.name: dest_delay_rate
features.description: Historical mean arrival delay (min) at destination hub, learned on the training split

features.name: carrier_delay_rate
features.description: Historical mean arrival delay (min) for the operating carrier, learned on the training split

features.name: carrier_weather_rate
features.description: Carrier historical mean weather-attributed delay (min)

features.name: carrier_nas_rate
features.description: Carrier historical mean NAS/airspace-attributed delay (min)

features.name: carrier_late_aircraft_rate
features.description: Carrier historical mean late-aircraft (propagated) delay (min)

features.name: route_delay_rate
features.description: Historical mean arrival delay (min) for this specific origin-destination pair

features.name: origin_hour_delay_rate
features.description: Historical mean arrival delay (min) for this origin at this UTC departure hour

features.name: carrier_origin_delay_rate
features.description: Historical mean arrival delay (min) for this carrier departing this origin

features.name: departure_hour_utc
features.description: Scheduled departure hour in Coordinated Universal Time (0-23)

features.name: local_departure_hour
features.description: Scheduled departure hour in the origin's local time (0-23)

features.name: day_of_week
features.description: Day of week (1=Monday, 7=Sunday)

features.name: scheduled_distance_nm
features.description: Great-circle nautical miles between origin and destination

features.name: scheduled_elapsed_hours
features.description: Scheduled flight block time in hours (CRSElapsedTime/60)

features.name: origin_weather_risk
features.description: Origin composite METAR severity index (0-100) matched to departure time

features.name: dest_weather_risk
features.description: Destination composite METAR severity index (0-100) matched to arrival time

features.name: origin_congestion_index
features.description: Origin hourly operations-to-capacity load factor (0-100)

features.name: dest_congestion_index
features.description: Destination hourly operations-to-capacity load factor (0-100)

features.name: origin_ifr_rate
features.description: Share of origin observations in degraded IMC/IFR conditions (0-1)

features.name: dest_ifr_rate
features.description: Share of destination observations in degraded IMC/IFR conditions (0-1)
